items.title: Add @test metadata for story query handlers
items.context: Add function-level @test annotations for story_migrate_storage and story_sync_main in packages/main/src/handlers/story-query.ts, without changing runtime logic.
items.userSees: cli-validate no longer prints WARN lines for story_migrate_storage or story_sync_main.

happy.desc: cli-validate reports Errors: 0 and Warnings: 0 after adding the two @test annotations.

edge.desc: git diff shows only @test annotation metadata changed in story-query.ts.

adversarial.desc: convergence_check remains converged:true after the warning cleanup.
